_doc: #11293: every browser stage that reads pixels/screenshots must be in floors (measured min/max over n runs, margin set from the spread) or in owed (not yet measured). A new pixel stage in neither fails noisefloorcheck. 'exact' = stage reads canvas/screenshots but measures no pixel value against a threshold (reason recorded); it needs no floor.

glintdrawcheck.margin: zombie screen box only, minimum over several samples (fixed in #11292/#11294)

mobdrawcheck.what: spider brightness spread across camera angles
mobdrawcheck.margin: judged against the cow comparator spread: spread < 40 + cowSpread (fixed in #11290)

spritecheck.what: quiet-control pixel diff (px of 434880); stick signal must exceed it
spritecheck.source: #11293 local runs 342/395/426 control; stick signal 1290..1616, boat control 313..324
spritecheck.margin: quiet gate is 0.1% = 435 px, only 9 above the worst control seen; retried up to 40 times by quietPair, signal is >3x control

weatherdrawcheck.what: raining on-vs-stubbed sampled pixel diff (signal); clear-sky control diff judged against its own drift
weatherdrawcheck.source: #11293 local runs: signal 29229/29222/29352/29503; clear control 238 vs drift 213
weatherdrawcheck.margin: signal gate is >200 (146x below the minimum seen); control is compared to its own measured drift, not a fixed number

underwaterdrawcheck.what: overlay-on vs base pixel diff (signal); base-vs-base noise; spectator diff
underwaterdrawcheck.margin: gate is signal > max(2000, 3*noise) and spectator < 0.5*signal: signal is 60x the gate, spectator 15x under its limit

bowdrawcheck.what: quiet-control px (gate total/2000, retried); arrow signal px must exceed max(20,4*control)
bowdrawcheck.source: #11293 local run: control 212, arrow 2761 > 848, bare skeleton 3955, pull-vs-idle 3099; 4 runs all passed (3 via suite, values printed only on the last)
bowdrawcheck.margin: gate adapts to the measured control (4x); signal 3.3x the gate; quiet control retried until under total/2000

inwalldrawcheck.what: mean brightness inside sandstone with overlay on (off-frame is the comparator)
inwalldrawcheck.source: #11293 local runs: on 20.0 x3 (deterministic), off 50.7..51.2, glass on=off 53.7..54.1
inwalldrawcheck.margin: gate is on<40 and on<0.6*off (30.7): 2x the measured on-value, 10 under the 0.6 limit

spawnerdraw.what: mob-coloured px in cage box vs draw-disabled control; px that rotate at 90 degrees
spawnerdraw.source: #11293 local runs: control 0 px, mob vs no-mob 1667, rotated 1373; 5 suite/direct runs all passed
spawnerdraw.margin: control is 0 (deterministic); gates are >0 against that control, signals >1000 px

titlecheck.what: straight-down view: sky fraction % and mean luma
titlecheck.margin: gates are sky<30% and 0.12<luma<0.92: luma is 3.5x over / 2.1x under its limits

becheck.what: quiet-control px (retried until <total/2000); object signal px must exceed max(40,3*control)
becheck.margin: gate adapts to the measured control (3x); smallest signal 1987 px is 5x the worst control and 50x the 40 px floor

crystalbeamdrawcheck.what: beam appearing/disappearing px diff (signal); background px over one step
crystalbeamdrawcheck.source: #11293 local runs: beam signal 3636..4421, bare crystal 5051..5390, background 348..364 (author notes swings 100-1200)
crystalbeamdrawcheck.margin: pixel gate is a fixed >60 BELOW the background noise on purpose; the real discriminator is the backend draw-call spy (18 calls). Signal is 10x background.

borderdrawcheck.what: world-border wall on-vs-off px diff (signal); off-vs-off noise
borderdrawcheck.source: #11316 local runs: signal 16109/16131/16314, noise 724/786/905, far 343..385; the bounced CI run saw noise 32877 vs signal 31876 (scene still changing)
borderdrawcheck.margin: gate is near > 200 + noise on a pair retried (up to 25x) until noise <= 3000, quietest kept: 5x under the local signal; a moving scene is retried, not judged

chunkborderdrawcheck.what: toggle-on delta px in line colours (signal); full-frame off-vs-off noise
chunkborderdrawcheck.source: #11293 local runs: delta 105680 x2 (deterministic), noise 13493..15073 (whole frame, not the colour-filtered count), off-state colour count 0
chunkborderdrawcheck.margin: gate is delta>150 on a colour-filtered count that is 0 when off: 700x under the signal; whole-frame noise is not used

cullcheck.what: luma-step noise floor (px) and the stage-measured control floor; on/off diffs are signal
cullcheck.source: #11293 tools/noisemeasure.mjs cullcheck 2: luma noise 0 and 0; sky-less control floors 137601/115680 and 217 vs signals 1949..357428
cullcheck.margin: cullcheck measures its own floor each run (rd line: pixels differ vs floor #, up to 3 attempts), so no fixed pixel number is gated

skyviewcheck.what: late-night star speck px (gate >30); full-moon lit px (phase counts 0..1593)
skyviewcheck.source: #11293 noisemeasure N=3 (1+2 runs): stars 103 x3, moon 1593 x3, all 8 phase counts identical every run (deterministic)
skyviewcheck.margin: stars gate >30 is 3.4x under the measured 103; the moon is deterministic

palettecheck.what: fancyLeaves flip: mean saturation moved (%) on a software-GL runner; world seed is random so leaf-in-shot varies
palettecheck.source: #11293 8 runs: 0.0,0.7,0.9,1.6,3.1,6.1,15.2 (+1); reference frame sat 0.39..0.67 before the sky was pinned; mipmaps no-remesh flip 0.3..9.9%
palettecheck.margin: the old hard gate sat>2% failed 4 of 8 runs; replaced by 'changed at all' (>0.05% sat or luma) with §2's changed-pixel count proving leaves in shot; sky (dayTime 6000, no weather) now pinned

exact.guitexcheck: 2D-canvas texel equality against the widget sheet (wrong===0); no GPU, no threshold
exact.titlescreencheck: hash of the 2D HUD canvas strip compared for equality; no GPU, no pixel-count threshold
exact.phonecontrolscheck: captureScreenshot only saves assets/phone-controls-*.png; assertions are DOM/protocol, no pixel measure
exact.phonerunscheck: captureScreenshot only saves assets/phone-runs-*.png; assertions are DOM (card counts, colours differ)
exact.phonevisualcheck: audits DOM geometry/contrast of the phone site; screenshots are artefacts, not measured
exact.blockcmdlivecheck: never screenshots; reads back game state only, no pixel threshold
exact.horsescreenpreviewcheck: reads the 2D HUD canvas (getImageData) for a drawn preview; deterministic, no compositor
exact.invpreviewcheck: reads the 2D HUD canvas (getImageData) for the inventory preview; deterministic, no compositor
exact.g11bcheck: reads the 2D HUD canvas (getImageData) ink counts; deterministic software-drawn 2D, no GPU frame
exact.inputcheck: reads the 2D HUD canvas (getImageData) for slot ink; deterministic, no GPU frame
exact.g10check: reads the HUD 2D canvas not a screenshot (immune to compositor, per its header); px floors are 2-3x below drawn size
exact.smoke: getImageData of the item sheet only (2D, deterministic); no screenshot diff
exact.g20acceptance: no pixel reads; acceptance of state
exact.diagcheck: 2D-canvas graph pixel count (lit>1500) from deterministic synthetic samples; no GPU frame
exact.soakcheck: no pixel reads; asserts on column/section counts over a flight
exact.sscheck: distinct-colour count >40 on a screenshot is a blank-frame guard, orders of magnitude from any noise (real frames have thousands)
exact.flashcheck: no pixel reads: counts frames/triangles/blank runs from the engine, screenshots only mentioned in comments
exact.piglinrendercheck: no pixel reads: asserts ER.build quad counts (file says: not a screenshot)
exact.g17cbcheck: every claim is made against a same-window control measured in the same run (control() at ~l.254), not a fixed pixel count
exact.g18ccheck: control diff re-taken up to 40 times until off-vs-off noise <1/2000 of the frame; claims compare to that control
exact.signtextdrawcheck: plain magnitude comparison between two live screenshots (file header); no fixed pixel threshold
exact.lumacheck: fence SPIKE=0.15 set from a measured healthy flight (worst 0.025, 6x margin), documented in file header per D-236
exact.panoramacheck: relative comparison of synthetic-face screenshots (dist vs spread over solid test faces), no golden or noisy pixel count
exact.mobsweepcheck: same file as mobdrawcheck (sweep section); its measured floor is recorded under mobdrawcheck
